subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should OpenClaw expose an operator-admin global auth refresh, and which reusable runtime owners and active sessions should it invalidate while preserving session identity and transcripts?
rationale: Current main has distinct embedded, CLI, ACP, and plugin runtime owners with different refresh behavior; source cannot safely choose the host-wide authorization, filtering, and interruption policy.

options.title: Scoped owner refresh RPC
options.body: Add a generic operator-admin refresh with agent/provider filters and runtime-owner hooks, preserving session and transcript state while defining active-run behavior.

options.title: Automatic mutation notifications
options.body: Have auth and config mutation flows notify affected runtime owners directly without exposing a general all-session RPC.

options.title: Document current behavior
options.body: Keep per-run refresh, CLI epochs, and manual session operations without promising an atomic global switch.

recommendation.title: Scoped owner refresh RPC
recommendation.body: Add a generic operator-admin refresh with agent/provider filters and runtime-owner hooks, preserving session and transcript state while defining active-run behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history spans both Gateway session lifecycle and credential-continuity code, matching this cross-owner decision.
